profile.headline: Web and Systems Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer / Systems Engineer with leadership experience. Strong background in web technologies, systems programming, Linux / UNIX OS. Open Source contributor in my spare time, projects can be found below.

Github: https://github.com/joshLong145

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer I
positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Rust (Programming Language) · Docker · Helm (Software) · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Protocol Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

- Enhanced delivery processes for core software products by optimizing CI/CD workflows.
- Led the development and integration of new features and functionality for core SDK products.
- Designed and implemented user-facing abstractions for essential network features.
- Provided critical feedback on proposals, contributing to the shaping of product roadmaps and implementation strategies.
-Developed and integrated abstractions for authentication operations, including:
    OTP/TOTP
    OAuth
    WebAuthn
    Signature verification
- Directed large-scale feature development, managing the entire implementation lifecycle.
- Collaborated with team members to integrate new cryptographic packages into core SDK and network modules, offering insights on design and performance improvements.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Rust (Programming Language) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Solidity · WebAssembly · Cloudflare · Domain Name System (DNS)

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

- Collaborated on designing the initial product architecture and led the development of the first product versions.
-Designed and implemented core business logic with a focus on WebAuthn authentication.
-Developed essential components for Web3 wallet integration.
-Contributed to defining business goals and aligning them with the product lifecycle.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with designers and fellow engineers to design and scale a mobile centric SDK for interfacing with blockchain primitives for Decentralized Identity Documents (DID) implemented in Go.
- Developed browser library for Webauthn authentication following the W3C specification implemented in TypeScript.
- Helped implemented an IPLD schema validation module for on chain data models implemented in Go.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · Go (Programming Language) · COSMOS · WebAssembly · vercel

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Feature implementation for ebedded application running on single core processor.
- Driver integration for COM application providing support for device communication over USB.
- Design and implementation of cross platform application providing abstraction for existing application suite
- implemented data aggregation system for telemetry data with ability to change transformation functions to increase readability and customization.
- implementation of custom component framework for dynamic JavaScipt API construction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Duties have included:
- Feature implementation for ebedded application running on single core processor.
- Driver integration for COM application providing support for device communication over USB.
- Design and implementation of cross platform application providing abstraction for existing application suite.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Currently tutor computer science 1 and 2, and data structures for the computer science department at Ramapo College.

positions.title: Firmware engineering intern
positions.description:
- Created example programs for user facing C# SDK.

- Worked on the design team for a new product. Hands on with all aspects of prototype design. 

- Researched new front facing programming language with focus on infrastructure stabilization.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on a small team to develop an in house tool for server monitoring.

- Designed a REST API with ASP.NET.

- Schema design for SQL server database.

-Front end programming with Type Script and Angular Material.

- C# programming against Windows API.

- Agile Scrum leader for a week (deligated tasks and ran team meetings).

positions.title: Jr Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a Junior software engineer migrating severs to in house hardware and creating in house tools for quality of life and in house source control.

honors.title: 3rd place award for JHacks hackathon.
honors.description: Created a Machine Learning application to asses risk of depression and anxiety from a users twitter data.

volunteerExperiences.description: Secretary of Ramapo College's Computer programming club. Have helped organize numerous workshops on campus dealing with both hardware and software topics.
